newsitem.title: UK: NWE gas oil under pressure, diesel looking for bid.
newsitem.headline: NWE gas oil under pressure, diesel looking for bid.

text.p: NWE gas oil prices slipped on Tuesday as increasingly distressed supply, including large volumes of low sulphur from the United States and Algeria, faced a market bereft of buyers, traders said.
IPE Nov futures fell 50 cents to $208.50 per tonne.
Diesel cargoes on the water from the United States and Algeria were offered at Dec IPE +$15 cif NWE and some sellers considered putting material into storage.
A small 7-8,000 tonne Russian diesel cargo was sold at mean of mean quotes +$13 cif Rotterdam.
Heating oil also seemed to come under renewed pressure, traders said, with a German DIN cargo offered into Hamburg for Nov 9 at Dec +$7.00 cif.
But Russian 0.2 sulphur cargoes were better supported after several loadings were sold into the Rotterdam market. A fob cargo was offered at mean of mean quotes -$4.50 fob Ventspils.
Heating oil barges were under pressure from the large U.S.-origin imports, with offers heard at Nov IPE flat fob and buyers at $1.00 discount.
